info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Warrego River downstream of Charleville, Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge and Warrego River at Rocky
info.description:
Minor flooding is occurring along the lower Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge and estimated to be occurring at Rocky.
The Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge was at 6.65 m at 5:45 am Friday and slowly falling, with minor flooding. The Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge is likely to remain above the minor flood level (6.00 m) through to early next week.
The Warrego River at Rocky is estimated to have peaked around the moderate flood level on Wednesday, based on upstream peaks. No current river level observations are available for the Warrego River at Rocky, however it is estimated to be slowly falling with minor flooding. The Warrego River at Rocky is likely to remain above the minor flood level (2.50 m) through to early next week.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
